newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent ends firm on NYMEX rally, French strike.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent ends firm on NYMEX rally, French strike.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures closed steady Monday after a late rally in New York and news of a strike at a French refinery took the market off early lows, brokers said.
Dec Brent closed 12 cents firmer at $24.65 a barrel, 27 cents off the session low posted in early afternoon trade.
Nov NYMEX crude oil's break above key psychological resistance at $26.00 a barrel -- a level not seen since January 1991 -- encouraged a wave of buying in London, brokers said.
"The market feels a little tired. A lot of people are sitting on long positions... and it could turn quickly," a broker said.

Markets had gained some ground over the weekend after oil industry leaders meeting with U.S. Energy Secretary Hazel O'Leary last Friday agreed only limited steps to avert a possible heating oil shortage this winter.

O'Leary said at least two companies had agreed to take steps to boost output. Citgo said it would delay maintenance to a catalytic cracker and Tosco would maximise refinery output earlier than normal, O'Leary said.
